26	    const normalizedReleasesFolder = releasesFolder.replace(/\\/gu, '/').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/gu, '')
27	    const prefix = `${normalizedReleasesFolder}/`
28	    if (!normalizedActivityPath.startsWith(prefix)) return null
29	    const releaseName = normalizedActivityPath.slice(prefix.length).split('/')[0]
30	
31	    return releaseName.length > 0 ? releaseName : null
32	}

35	    const hasCost = activity.conversations.some((conversation) => conversation.usage?.costUsd !== undefined)
36	    const costUsd = activity.conversations.reduce((total, conversation) => total + (conversation.usage?.costUsd ?? 0), 0)

206	    private async enqueueOperation(loadedProject: LoadedProjectUsage, operation: () => Promise<void>) {
207	        while (this.operationPromise) {
208	            const activeOperation = this.operationPromise
209	            try {
210	                await activeOperation
211	            } catch {
212	                // A queued operation reports through its own caller. Continue with current work.
213	            }
214	            if (this.operationPromise === activeOperation) this.operationPromise = null
215	        }
216	        if (!this.isCurrentProject(loadedProject)) return
217	
218	        const operationPromise = operation()
219	        this.operationPromise = operationPromise
220	        try {
221	            await operationPromise
222	        } finally {
223	            if (this.operationPromise === operationPromise) this.operationPromise = null
224	        }
225	    }
